# Platform records

A platform deployment records where every deployed directory came from, which platform is active, and which platform it replaced; infra records every lab session, which the platform's controller reads; the GPU arbiter records where every published dataset and every registered adapter came from ([GPU arbiter requests](gpu-arbiter.md)). The records are part of contract v2; their JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12) are in `contract/records/`, next to the schema of the environment fingerprint (see [Fingerprint](fingerprint.md)).

## DEPLOYED_FROM.json

Provenance of a deployed platform release or content package (contract v2, BUILD_PROMPT §12.10). Written by infra at the root of every deployed release and content package, root-owned and read-only. Schema file: `contract/records/deployed-from.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `kind` | one of `release`, `content` | yes | The release, or a content package. |
| `package` | string or null | yes | Content package name; null for the release. |
| `restricted` | boolean | yes | A restricted content package (deployed only into the restricted area). |
| `source` | object | yes | The source setting the deployment used. |
| `source.repo` | string | yes | Repository URL (SSH, anonymous HTTPS or file://). |
| `source.ref` | string | yes | The requested tag, branch or full commit. |
| `source.path` | string | yes | Subdirectory in the repository; empty for the root. |
| `source.tag_prefix` | string | yes | Prefix of the source's release tags. |
| `commit` | string | yes | The deployed commit. |
| `tree` | string | yes | Git tree of the deployed path at that commit. |
| `tag` | string or null | yes | Release tag with the source's prefix that the commit carries, if any. |
| `signed_tag` | object | yes | Signature check of the release tag. |
| `signed_tag.required` | boolean | yes | require_signed_tags was set. |
| `signed_tag.verified` | boolean | yes | The tag carries a valid signature of an allowed signer. |
| `signed_tag.signer` | string or null | yes | The signer's principal, when verified. |
| `platform` | object | yes | The platform release this deployment belongs to. |
| `platform.name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `platform.version` | string | yes | SemVer of the release. |
| `platform.runtime` | one of `python-uv`, `static` | yes | Runtime of the release. |
| `platform.manifest_sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of platform-manifest.yaml. |
| `deployed_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the deployment. |

## active.json

The active platform of the lab, /etc/pinka/platform/active.json (contract v2, BUILD_PROMPT §7.14 "One platform per lab", §12.10). Written by infra when a deployment is switched on; 0644 root. Schema file: `contract/records/active-platform.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `version` | string | yes | SemVer of the active release. |
| `runtime` | one of `python-uv`, `static` | yes | Runtime of the release. |
| `manifest_sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the release's manifest. |
| `release` | object | yes | The active release. |
| `release.name` | string | yes | Directory name: the tag, or the full commit. |
| `release.commit` | string | yes | — |
| `release.tree` | string | yes | — |
| `release.tag` | string or null | yes | — |
| `release.target` | string | yes | Path of the deployed directory. |
| `release.restricted` | boolean | no | — |
| `content` | object | yes | The active content packages by name. |
| `content.*` | object | no | any key; value as described |
| `services` | array | yes | The platform's services with their profiles. |
| `services[].name` | string | yes | — |
| `services[].profile` | string | yes | — |
| `jobs` | array | yes | The platform's training jobs. |
| `jobs[].name` | string | yes | — |
| `cli` | string or null | yes | Name of the researchers' CLI, if any. |
| `names` | object | yes | Every name the deployment creates, by reserved-name namespace; they count as the platform's own in the host check of its next release. |
| `names.*` | array | no | any key; value as described |
| `activated_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the switch. |

## retired.json

A platform replaced by another (--replace-platform), `/var/lib/pinka/platforms/<platform>/retired.json`, 0600 root. pinka platform purge reads it and sets purged_at. Schema file: `contract/records/retired-platform.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `retired_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the replacement. |
| `replaced_by` | string | yes | The platform that replaced it. |
| `purged_at` | string or null | yes | UTC time of the purge, or null. |
| `active` | object | yes | Its active platform record (active-platform.schema.json) at the time of the replacement. |

## session record

One lab session: `/var/lib/pinka/sessions/<boot_id>.json`, 0644 root, written once per boot by pinka-session-start.service (BUILD_PROMPT §7.16) and read by the platform's controller. A field that could not be computed is null, with the reason under errors. Schema file: `contract/records/session-record.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `boot_id` | string | yes | The kernel's boot ID (/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); the file name. |
| `started_at` | string | yes | UTC time the session started. |
| `fingerprint_hash` | string or null | yes | hash of the fingerprint; null if it could not be computed. |
| `fingerprint` | object or null | yes | The environment fingerprint document (fingerprint.schema.json); null if it could not be computed. |
| `preflight_outcome` | one of `supported`, `degraded`, `unsupported`, `needs_action`, `null` | yes | Preflight's outcome at the session's start; null if preflight failed. |
| `errors` | object | yes | Why a field is null, by field. |
| `errors.fingerprint` | string | no | Why the fingerprint could not be computed. |
| `errors.preflight` | string | no | Why preflight produced no outcome. |

## PROVENANCE.json

Provenance of a published training dataset: `/srv/pinka/training/datasets/<sha256>/PROVENANCE.json`, written by the GPU arbiter when the controller publishes the dataset (`publish-dataset`, BUILD_PROMPT §7.18), root:pinka-datasets 0640. The arbiter refuses to publish or mount a dataset that lists an instance of the `test` split; that the list is complete and truthful is the platform's obligation. Schema file: `contract/records/dataset-provenance.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `dataset_sha256` | string | yes | The dataset hash (see files); the directory name. |
| `published_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the publication. |
| `platform` | object | yes | The platform release that built the dataset (the builder's platform commit). |
| `platform.name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `platform.version` | string | yes | SemVer of the active release. |
| `platform.commit` | string | yes | Commit of the active release (DEPLOYED_FROM.json). |
| `instances` | array | yes | Every scenario instance included in the dataset, with its split. |
| `instances[].id` | string | yes | Scenario instance ID. |
| `instances[].split` | string | yes | The instance's split; never `test`. |
| `source_runs` | array | yes | The runs the dataset was built from. |
| `files` | array | yes | Every regular file of the dataset, sorted by the path's UTF-8 bytes (as `LC_ALL=C sort` sorts, whatever the locale); the dataset hash is the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the UTF-8 lines `&lt;sha256&gt;  &lt;path&gt;` of this list (lowercase hex, two spaces, the path), each ending in a newline (the output format of `sha256sum`). |
| `files[].path` | string | yes | Path relative to the dataset's directory, with / separators and no leading ./; UTF-8 without control characters or backslashes, so its line is unambiguous. |
| `files[].sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the file's content. |
| `files[].size` | integer | yes | Size in bytes. |

## adapter MANIFEST.json

A registered adapter: `/srv/pinka/models/adapters/<name>/<sha256>/MANIFEST.json`, written by the GPU arbiter when a training run succeeds (BUILD_PROMPT §7.18), root-owned and read-only. Deployment specs name the adapter as `<name>@<sha256>` in `adapter_ids`. Schema file: `contract/records/adapter-manifest.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `name` | string | yes | Adapter name: the job's `outputs.adapter`. |
| `sha256` | string | yes | The adapter hash (see files); the directory name. |
| `base_model_id` | string or null | yes | Model id (models.lock.yml) of the base model the adapter was trained on; null for a job without a base model. vLLM serves the adapter only with this model. |
| `run` | string | yes | The training run that produced it. |
| `registered_at` | string | yes | UTC time of the registration. |
| `files` | array | yes | Every regular file of the adapter, sorted by the path's UTF-8 bytes (as `LC_ALL=C sort` sorts, whatever the locale); the adapter hash is the SHA-256, in lowercase hex, of the UTF-8 lines `&lt;sha256&gt;  &lt;path&gt;` of this list (lowercase hex, two spaces, the path), each ending in a newline (the output format of `sha256sum`). |
| `files[].path` | string | yes | Path relative to the adapter's directory, with / separators and no leading ./; UTF-8 without control characters or backslashes, so its line is unambiguous. |
| `files[].sha256` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the file's content. |
| `files[].size` | integer | yes | Size in bytes. |

## adapter LINEAGE.json

Where a registered adapter came from: `/srv/pinka/models/adapters/<name>/<sha256>/LINEAGE.json`, written by the GPU arbiter with MANIFEST.json (BUILD_PROMPT §7.18), root-owned and read-only; the controller imports it. Schema file: `contract/records/adapter-lineage.schema.json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_version` | constant `1` | yes | Version of this record format. |
| `adapter` | object | yes | The adapter. |
| `adapter.name` | string | yes | Adapter name. |
| `adapter.sha256` | string | yes | Adapter hash. |
| `base_model` | object or null | yes | The base model, verified against its MANIFEST.json (models.lock.yml's hashes) before the run; null for a job without a base model. |
| `base_model.id` | string | yes | Model ID in models.lock.yml. |
| `base_model.hf_repo` | string | yes | Hugging Face repository. |
| `base_model.revision` | string | yes | Pinned revision. |
| `base_model.files` | array | yes | The base model's files with their verified hashes. |
| `base_model.files[].path` | string | yes | File in the repository. |
| `base_model.files[].sha256` | string | yes | Verified SHA-256. |
| `datasets` | array | yes | Hashes of the datasets mounted into the run. |
| `image` | object | yes | The job's container image. |
| `image.reference` | string | yes | The job's image reference from the manifest. |
| `image.digest` | string | yes | Its digest. |
| `job` | object | yes | The training run. |
| `job.name` | string | yes | Job name in the manifest. |
| `job.run` | string | yes | Run ID. |
| `job.spec_sha256` | string | yes | Job-spec hash: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the submission. |
| `hyperparameters` | object | yes | The submission's hyperparameters. |
| `seed` | integer | yes | The submission's seed. |
| `platform` | object | yes | The active platform release. |
| `platform.name` | string | yes | Platform name. |
| `platform.version` | string | yes | SemVer of the active release. |
| `platform.commit` | string | yes | Commit of the active release (DEPLOYED_FROM.json). |
| `infra` | object | yes | The infrastructure release. |
| `infra.commit` | string or null | yes | Infra's commit (/etc/pinka/bootstrap-state.json); null if unknown. |
| `started_at` | string | yes | UTC start of the run. |
| `ended_at` | string | yes | UTC end of the run. |
